sloka: पुरा वैदर्भको राजा पिता मम महायशाः ।सुदेव इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान् ।। ७.७८.३ ॥
transliteration: purā vaidarbhako rājā pitā mama mahāyaśāḥ ।sudeva iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu vīryavān ।। 7.78.3 ॥

translations.english: Formerly, my father was a greatly renowned and valorous king of Vidarbha, famous in all three worlds by the name Sudeva.
